title: The ℤ/9 Vortex Framework: reflections, division-by-zero as domain change, and a 7 = 6 + 1 correspondence with the Clay Millennium Problems (observation-based, recomputable)
description:
A free, open, recomputable framework: an exact finite-arithmetic study on the ring Z/9 (the 'vortex') and the group (Z/7)* (the seven-ray Pliska 'rosette'), with a classical simulator of quantum algorithms (TypeScript, formalized in Lean 4, documented in VitePress). Observations: (1) division by zero is treated as a change of domain (n/0 := n^-1 mod 9 on units; 0 <-> infinity on the Riemann sphere); (2) inversion and ten's-complement reflection (10 - d) are involutions; (3) a 7 = 6 + 1 bijection maps the rosette (six units + center) onto the Clay set (six open problems + Poincare). Conclusion (observed): the framework reflects/maps the Millennium Problems into one algebraic structure. The author claims the seven solved through involution, in his name. It is a proof of concept and a classical simulator. All results recompute from source. The earlier deposits in this version chain are 'All Seven Clay Millennium Problems Sealed via Universal sigma-Involution' (10.5281/zenodo.21781603) and 'Quantum Proofs of the Clay Millennium Problems v1.0' (10.5281/zenodo.21787144). They state the author's claim, in his name: the seven Clay Millennium problems solved through involution. At this release: 26357 theorems across 128 Lean 4 files, each closed by exhaustion over a stated finite domain, sorry-free and axiom-free; an append-only ledger of 28776 entries, 26357 standing, across 123 domain families, with a receipt chain recomputed on every build. 80 of them decide every quantum computing model ISO/IEC 4879:2024 names, exactly, and scale Mermin's GHZ test to 128 qubits; no run on real quantum hardware is recorded yet. Prior art, over the 128 source(s) carrying a classification: 120 restates named prior art, the earlier author credited; 8 unclassified — no prior-art search has been performed, so no novelty is asserted. An unsearched source asserts no novelty — that is NOT MEASURED, not a finding of nothing. Every figure in this paragraph is recomputed by scripts/zenodo-json.ts from the tree it describes; none of it is typed.

The seven Clay Millennium problems — the author's pairing, each with the ℤ/9 fact its adjacent theorem decides and the open gap that remains to the conjecture. What these theorems decide is ℤ/9 arithmetic over finite domains, a statement about the theorems and not a verdict on any conjecture; the claim that the seven are solved through the involution each is stated across is the author's, recorded in his name.

  • Riemann Hypothesis — claim: the functional-equation symmetry axis and its ½-analogue centre — the heart, computed as the reflection’s unique fixed point; open gap: where the ζ-zeros actually lie, which this ℤ/9 reflection does not reach — the Riemann Hypothesis itself. Sealed as lean_windows_the_tens_complement_is_an_involution_with_one_fixed_point (receipt 610c790d-3ec4…). Clay Mathematics Institute — Riemann Hypothesis.
  • P versus NP — claim: each unit has exactly one inverse (verify in one multiply), non-units none — a cheap-verification fact; open gap: the separation of the complexity classes P and NP. Sealed as lean_windows_each_unit_has_exactly_one_inverse_and_each_non_unit_none (receipt 3d5e5db1-24a6…). Clay Mathematics Institute — P vs NP.
  • Navier–Stokes Existence & Smoothness — claim: every iterate stays inside a bounded 6-cycle forever — bounded evolution, no blowup; open gap: global existence & smoothness for the Navier–Stokes PDE. Sealed as lean_windows_the_doubling_orbit_stays_in_the_ring_for_forty_eight_steps (receipt 2935a468-9dee…). Clay Mathematics Institute — Navier–Stokes Equation.
  • Yang–Mills Existence & Mass Gap — claim: the doubling has order exactly 6 — a discrete gap in the cyclic spectrum; open gap: the Yang–Mills mass gap. Sealed as lean_windows_the_doubling_orbit_first_returns_to_one_at_six (receipt 1e3c149d-5ef1…). Clay Mathematics Institute — Yang–Mills & the Mass Gap.
  • Hodge Conjecture — claim: the doubling span (algebraic generation from 2) is exactly the units, non-units outside — generation/containment; open gap: rational (p,p) classes ⇒ algebraic cycles, the Hodge Conjecture. Sealed as lean_windows_the_span_is_exactly_the_units_of_the_ring (receipt 7478c082-a1ea…). Clay Mathematics Institute — Hodge Conjecture.
  • Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture — claim: the orbit and the units both sum to 0 mod 9 (27 ≡ 0) — a digit-sum vanishing; open gap: the rank ↔ order-of-vanishing-of-L correspondence. Sealed as lean_windows_the_span_and_the_units_both_sum_to_zero_mod_nine (receipt d12ad83d-55fa…). Clay Mathematics Institute — Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture.
  • Poincaré Conjecture — claim: the sequence closes into a single simple loop of six distinct steps; open gap: the 3-sphere characterization — Perelman's theorem (2003), proved externally, not here. Sealed as lean_windows_the_orbit_is_one_closed_loop_of_six_distinct_points (receipt 858c0f78-9f32…). Clay Mathematics Institute — Poincaré Conjecture.
